pages.text: The Fuel Cell, a burnable canister forged from Akaishi Ingots, is the reactor's "lunchbox".$(li)The Fuel Filler pours burnable mass into it$(li)The Fuel Mixer blends end / dragon / world-base mixtures$(li)Fuel rods and fusion rods combine in the Fusion Fuel Aggregator into fusion reaction rods$(li)The Plasma Filler loads plasma into rods → plasma fuel rods$(br2)It's a long chain, but every link leads to a hotter fire.

Heat sinks come in 6 tiers (rough → refined → fine → good → excellent → ultimate) built tier by tier, plus fusion heat sinks (tiers 1-5 + life-grade).$(br)Heat sinks are stacked from a Cooling Base + dust step by step. Whether the reactor and fusion reactor hold their temperature is entirely up to them.
